description: This file defines a LimitManager class for managing busy time limits, including creating, checking, and merging busy time entries, as well as related utility functions and constants for limit sources.

classes.name: LimitManager
classes.description: A class for managing busy time limits, including creating, checking, and merging busy time entries.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for busy map entries based on start time, interval unit, and optional timezone.

methods.name: isAlreadyBusy
methods.description: Checks if a given start time and interval unit are already marked as busy, considering hierarchical overlaps.

methods.name: addBusyTime
methods.description: Adds a new busy time entry with specified start, unit, timezone, title, and source.

methods.name: mergeBusyTimes
methods.description: Merges busy times from another LimitManager instance into this one.

methods.name: getBusyTimes
methods.description: Returns an array of all busy time entries.
